# SPEC §7.5 shard assignment — the WITNESS for the partition rule.
#
#   shard(h, p, n) = first_64_bits(SHA-256(h ++ "#" ++ decimal(p))) mod n
#
# `h` is the 64-char LOWERCASE HEX spelling, not the 32 bytes it denotes;
# the separator is one '#'; decimal(p) is base ten, no padding, no sign;
# first_64_bits is the digest's leading 8 bytes big-endian.
#
# n=1 is the unsharded verifier and is 0 throughout — the only column whose
# correct value is known without computing a digest, and so the one that
# catches a file regenerated from a broken rule.
#
# name	hash	prop	n=1	n=2	n=3	n=7	n=8	n=32	n=100
